page.layout: One printed page, one text column with a running head and page number at the top. Above the text a continuation paragraph and a list of nine axioms (italic, numbered). Below the list the division heading, a sub-heading, and the opening paragraph of the text. One marginal note in the right margin beside the first paragraph. The left margin has only show-through and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: quæ earum[?] personæ rei cohærent, eamque concernunt: uti be-neficii competentiæ, in quantum facere potest, &c. quasi[?] scili-cet exceptiones personæ favor obtinuit, non causæ conditio. v. Tuld. hic c.f. l.13.ff.de minor. l.68. de R.I. adde iit. seq. §. ult.]
main_text.head: AXIOMATA.

p.i: 1. Exceptiones reorum defendendorum gratia comparatæ sunt, in pr
2. Sæp[?] quod justum est, iniquum est, eod. princ. vide Ariftot. lib. §. [?]thic: cap. pen.
3. Pactum conventum non tollit obligationem ipso jure, sed ope'ex-ceptionis. §. 3.
4. Ieni[?]um est, aliquem contra pacta condemnari. d. §, 3. quia pa-[?]unt servenda. supra de soc: axiom.1.
5. Iniquum est de perjurio quæri. §. 4. conjun. l. quod si deferen-te. 1.ff.de dolo.
6. Sententia absolutoria non tollit actionem ipso jure, sed ope ex-ceptionis. §. 5.
7. Ni[?] non potest fieri procurator, nisi in rem suam. §. ult. conjun. 1. & 1.9, C.de procuratorib.
9. Infamis[?] in judicio procurator jure civili esse potest. d. §. ult. jure canonico non potest. 5. quæst.1. cap. infamis & cap. seq.

main_text.head: TITVLVS XIV.
main_text.p: Titulo subjiciuntur aliæ duæ exceptionum divisiones.
main_text.head: DE REPLICATIONIBUS.
main_text.p: INterdum evenit, ut exceptio, quæ prima Quomodo introduci-tur Re-plicatio?facie justa videtur, tamen inique noceat, quod cum accidit, alia allegatione opus est, adjuvandi actoris gratia, quæ replicatio vocatur; quia per eam replicatur, atque re-jus exceptionis, veluti cum pactus est aliquis cum debitore[?] suo, ne ab eo pecuniam petat, deinde postea in[illegible, ~5 letters]rium pacti sunt, id est, ut creditori petere liceat: creditor agat, & excipiat debitor, ut ita demum con-demne-

page.notes: Show-through and edge bleed on the left margin not transcribed. Uncertain or partly hidden readings are marked [?]: the first word of the continuation paragraph; "quasi"; the opening letters of several axioms (4, 7, 9) and "Sæp"; "lib. §. thic" in axiom 2 (probably "lib. 5. Ethic"); "debitore"; and "Ceb" fragments. Axiom 1 ends with "in pr" as printed, probably a line-end fragment. The word after "in" on the line with "rium" is hidden; the illegible marker covers it. The left edge of the heading "DE REPLICATIONIBUS." is faint. A faint mark before "Titulo" is not transcribed. The initial letter is a decorated woodcut, read as I.
